issue-4201: Password reset email links to localhost
Opened by mkowalczyk on 2026-09-08

I clicked "Forgot password" on the login page. The email arrived within a
minute, but the link in it goes to

    http://localhost:3000/reset-password?token=…

which of course doesn't load for me. Two people on m

args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

Use the configured application public URL or environment settings instead of falling back to localhost:3000 in `BASE_URL`, or read the correct base URL from config/environment so password reset emails contain the production domain.
args.title: Use production base URL for password reset email links
